subject: prd/e2e-verification
statement: How e2e-design selects the governing design when a feature has multiple or superseded technical designs — §5.5 reads "its technical design" (singular) and UB-2 refuses only missing/unreadable, so a present-but-superseded design would slip through; pick the live (non-superseded) set, surface or refuse on ambiguity
rationale: open — design-owned; v1 assumes a single live design
